ns2:section.sectionText: Blended learning pedagogical design that combines online video lectures and test reviews with a high-engagement, student-centered in-class environment. Topical coverage is aligned with sequencing of ME 340 labs. ME students must obtain department approval from staff in 154 MEB to drop this course after the 10th day of class.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Mechanics or Mechanical Engineering major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
